component.name: Berth
component.summary: A light, native Docker desktop for Linux

description.p: Berth manages the Docker Engine you already run: containers grouped by Compose project, live logs, a shell, a file browser, images with Docker Hub search, volumes, networks, build cache, resource graphs and disk clean-up.
No virtual machine and no background service. It talks straight to the Docker socket, reads live stats from the kernel, pauses them when you are not looking, and exits when you close the window.

screenshot.caption: Log explorer with a level histogram

description.p: Layout fixes for small windows and large fonts, and the fast renderer on older GTK versions.
Opens in about a second, with a first-run welcome that connects your engine and runs a first container.
The new Berth logo: a container ship on a wave, on every platform.
A redesigned interface with consistent page headers, tables in cards and an 8-point spacing system, plus accessibility settings: text size, density, stronger borders, larger icons and reduced motion.
Fixes the build history page, adds an Unhealthy filter and status-bar alert.
